roles.independent_current_scope: Input policy, full-document boundaries, actual font/glyph calibration, input counts and raw-file boundary; no factor or mathematical rereview.
roles.prior_contribution: Reviewer authored phase236 inherited mathematics and previously reviewed publication integration.
roles.nonself_mathematical_acceptance: The distinct phase248 and current F independent review, plus root adoption, supply the inherited mathematical acceptance. They are reused, not replaced by this measurement review.

font_audit.ordinary_remaining_glyphs: Compared actual embedded glyph names to Adobe glyph names with explicit reviewed variant-name exceptions; parser and name semantics remain declared trust.
font_audit.not_claimed: No full formula semantics, mathematical proof validation or complete layout-preserving transcription.

visual_review.method: Independent Ghostscript renders, all page contact sheets inspected, source pages3/8/9 also enlarged, actual embedded-font outline sheet viewed. The outline plotting helper is reused and its source read; character-event and embedded encoding checks are independent.
visual_review.source_boundaries: Full title, abstract, arXiv banner, all body/theorem/formula/table text, acknowledgements, references and contacts retained. Only exact repeated running headers/page numbers removed.
visual_review.own_boundaries: All title, body, proofs, attribution, references, appendix commentary and complete code retained; only physical page footers removed. Printed continuation marks remain counted.
visual_review.formula_policy: Each visible tall-bracket piece counts separately; no equation repair/reordering/dehyphenation. The literal source marking remains as printed.
visual_review.source_image_dimensions: all one pixel by one pixel, independently inventoried; placement/rules/overlines not priced

cost_boundary.written_first: whole L014 versus whole U_F plus whole F1
cost_boundary.program_representation: Whole four-page CODE appendix once, or all three complete raw programs as an alternative; never both.
cost_boundary.conditional: After acquiring whole U_F and complete validation package.
cost_boundary.operational_engineering_cost: Only separate raw text counts; no total engineering-cost assertion.
cost_boundary.complete_source_claim: Full-document numerator is for the declared principal contract with explicit exclusions; no recovery of every printed auxiliary assertion.

limitations: Shared pypdf/fontTools parser and Unicode normalization are declared computational dependencies.
Text metrics are not proof complexity, semantic information, or the cost of diagrams/retained outside theory.
